facts.text: A near miss is an event that could have caused a collision or injury but did not, usually because someone stopped, swerved or was lucky.
facts.quote: A near miss is an event that could have caused a collision or injury but did not, usually because someone stopped, swerved or was lucky.

facts.text: Two haul trucks meeting on the wrong side of a dark haul road and making emergency stops 15 m apart is an example of a near miss.
facts.quote: Two haul trucks meeting on the wrong side of a dark haul road and making emergency stops 15 m apart is a near miss

facts.text: Near misses often go unrecorded because nobody is hurt.
facts.quote: Nobody is hurt, so such events often go unrecorded.

facts.text: Queensland's regulator warns that collision near misses in surface mines are under-reported.
facts.quote: Queensland's regulator warns that collision near misses in surface mines are under-reported

facts.text: New Zealand's regulator said its incident data were incomplete because few quarries reported incidents.
facts.quote: New Zealand's said its incident data were incomplete because few quarries reported

facts.text: Queensland recorded 48 mobile-equipment collisions and near misses at open-cut coal mines in five months of 2017.
facts.quote: Queensland recorded 48 mobile-equipment collisions and near misses at open-cut coal mines in five months of 2017

facts.text: Near misses are valuable for tuning an automatic-braking system because fatal accidents are far too rare to tune the system on.
facts.quote: Near misses are precious for an automatic-braking program because fatal accidents are far too rare to tune a system on.

facts.text: The booklet recommends logging every warning and intervention with machine state, load, grade, speed, target class, weather, light, operator response, whether braking was necessary, and task phase.
facts.quote: The booklet recommends logging every warning and intervention with machine state, load, grade, speed, target class, weather, light, operator response, whether braking was necessary, and task phase

facts.text: Existing warning-system logs are biased because a warning may cause the operator to brake, leaving few natural examples of what would have happened without the warning.
facts.quote: an existing warning may make the operator brake, so the data contain few natural examples of what would have happened without it

facts.text: Near misses in which the warning was ignored are the most valuable records, but these events are often not logged with ground truth.
facts.quote: the near misses where the warning was ignored, the most valuable records, are often not logged with ground truth

facts.text: Near-miss and intervention logs are the main source of realistic test scenarios and of the exposure model for the automatic-braking program.
facts.quote: Near-miss and intervention logs are the main source of realistic test scenarios and of the exposure model

facts.text: The four-month automatic-braking test campaign should be treated as the start of a living evidence base fed by field near misses, rather than as a one-time dataset.
facts.quote: the four-month campaign should be seen as the start of a living evidence base fed by field near misses, not a one-time dataset
